story.title: Nvidia has already committed $40B to equity AI deals in 2026, cementing its role as AI kingmaker
story.summary: Nvidia has invested $40 billion in equity deals across the AI ecosystem in the first months of 2026, signalling that the chipmaker is rapidly evolving from hardware supplier into a strategic power broker across the industry. The investments span AI infrastructure, frontier model labs, and application-layer startups. Analysts note that Nvidia's capital deployment pace has accelerated sharply compared to prior years.
